title: 1 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Timothy 3: what is required of an overseer and of servants, and the mystery of godliness at the end of the chapter.

questions.text: What does someone who seeks to be an overseer desire, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 calls it a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

questions.text: What does verse 2 say about the overseer's marriage?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says the overseer must be without reproach, the husband of one wife.

answers.text: He must be the husband of one wife
He must marry within the assembly

questions.text: Which three things does verse 3 say the overseer must not be?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle and not quarrelsome.

answers.text: A teacher, a traveler, or a worker
A drinker, violent, or greedy for money

questions.text: What must the overseer rule well, according to verses 4 and 5?
questions.explanation: Verses 4 and 5 ask how someone who doesn't know how to rule his own house could take care of God's assembly.

questions.text: What must the overseer not be, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he must not be a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

answers.text: A man who works with his hands

questions.text: From whom must he have good testimony, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

answers.text: From the rulers of the city

questions.text: What must happen before servants are allowed to serve?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

answers.text: They must first be taught the law
They must first sell what they have
They must first be older men

questions.text: What does verse 11 require of their wives?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says their wives must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

questions.text: What is God's house called in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 calls it the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

answers.text: The house of prayer for all nations
The city of the living God
The pillar and ground of the truth

questions.text: What does verse 16 say about the mystery of godliness?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

answers.text: God was revealed in the flesh
It is hidden from the angels
It was written by the prophets
It is kept by the overseers
